name: Au(111) slab, 4x4, 5 layers
description: Orthogonal 4x4 Au(111) surface cell with 5 layers (80 atoms), 15 Angstrom of vacuum above the slab only, and the bottom two layers frozen with selective dynamics.

calculation.notes: Ideal bulk-terminated geometry. Check the lattice constant against your own functional before production runs.

notes: 32 of 80 atoms are fixed (F F F). Surface cell is orthogonal, so ny must be even.
